## Notes

Evolution factor rises with time, total pollution produced, and destroyed spawners (0.002 each by default), squashed as total/(1+total); enemies attack only when the pollution cloud reaches nests; absorbed pollution recruits units (small biter 4, behemoth biter 400); attack groups launch every 1 to 10 minutes.
